children: Capital Group, a global investment manager with $3.6 trillion of assets under management, has secured a licence from the Abu Dhabi’s international financial centre to operate as a regulated investment manager.
The approval authorises Capital Group to conduct trading, investment management and distribution activities within ADGM and in the region.
The move follows the asset manager’s May 2026 announcement of plans to establish its first Middle East office in Abu Dhabi.

To deepen its regional presence, the firm has relocated associates from North America, Europe and Asia, enhancing access to investment, operational and client-facing expertise. The local team is expected to grow over time, reflecting the firm's business ambitions and client needs in the region.
New Mountain Capital, an alternative investment firm based in New York, said on Tuesday it was opening an office in ADGM to ramp up its presence in the region.
(Writing by Brinda Darasha; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Capital Group secures ADGM licence to expand Middle East operations
